Regionalization by global linear regression (C2)

Source: R/regionalize-methods.R
ef_method_ols.Rd

Describes configuration C2-OLS for ef_regionalize() and ef_regionalize_cv() (dev/specs/gwr-forcing.md sections 5.2 and 5.4): ordinary least squares on the same covariates (all layers of covariates) as GWR, $$\hat\beta = (X^\top X)^{-1} X^\top y, \qquad \hat y_g = x_g^\top \hat\beta,$$ the limit of GWR for an infinite bandwidth. It separates the contribution of the covariates from that of the non-stationarity.

Usage

ef_method_ols()

Value

A list of class "earthflux_regionalization_method" with method = "global_ols".

Details

Diagnostics use the definitions of the GWR core with tr(S) = p: AICc of ef_gwr_bandwidth() and leave-one-out residuals \(e_i/(1 - h_{ii})\).

Verification status

Ordinary least squares is standard; its use as the C2 reference is a design choice (GW-21). It reproduces the global reference of ef_gwr_fit() (tested).

See also

Other spatial regionalization functions: ef_gwr_bandwidth(), ef_gwr_diagnostics(), ef_gwr_fit(), ef_gwr_predict(), ef_gwr_search(), ef_method_gwr(), ef_method_idw(), ef_method_station(), ef_predict_control(), ef_regionalize(), ef_regionalize_cv(), ef_spatial_folds()

Examples

ef_method_ols()
#> <earthflux_regionalization_method> global_ols 
#> global ordinary least squares on all covariates
